text: Which rule is the recursor for natural numbers in MLTT?
choices: elim-ℕ (with base case and step case, returning a type depending on the number)
ℕ-elim only with motive in a fixed universe
Primitive recursion without dependent return type
explanation: ind-ℕ (or rec-ℕ) is a dependent recursor: given P:ℕ→Type, p₀:P(0), pₛ:(∀n.P(n)→P(s n)), returns ∀n.P(n).
